effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Return 1 Digimon card from your trash to your hand. Then, 1 of your Digimon with [Garurumon] in its name gains "[On Deletion] Play this card without paying its cost." until the end of your opponent's turn.
